project.title: SSC CSD R&D
project.role: AWS Cloud Infrastructure as Code DevOps Engineer & Architect

role_overview.summary: Shared Services Canada's Cloud Services Directorate (CSD) R&D group is mandated to create reusable, government-grade Infrastructure as Code for adoption across SSC and its federal partner departments. Christian served as AWS Cloud Infrastructure as Code DevOps Engineer and Architect, leading the design and delivery of the CSD Landing Zone — an ASEA-integrated, multi-account AWS architecture with codified security guardrails, SSO federation with Azure Active Directory, and ITSG-22/33/38-aligned controls — culminating in SSC becoming the first team to achieve ATO status using the AWS Secure Environment Accelerator. The engagement also supported the onboarding of critical government workloads including SCED, DX, Vocalls, and Email.

challenge.summary: The CSD R&D Project group are focused on generating a set of deployable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for re-use within SSC and partners. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) supports automation of 'CSD Landing Zone' integrating AWS Landing Zone customisation, SAA Security Guard Rails, and generic multi-purpose tools. Developed and drove success and security achievements to ATO with AWS Secure Environment Accelerator.

solution.summary: Delivered comprehensive cloud and infrastructure solutions across:
deliverables: Cloud Services Directorate, Cloud Platform Engineering Project

outcomes: ✅ First team to achieve ATO status using AWS Secure Environment Accelerator (ASEA), establishing reusable Infrastructure as Code templates for government-wide adoption
✅ Created foundational 'CSD Landing Zone' architecture that became the standard for SSC cloud deployments, supporting critical workloads including SCED, DX, and Email systems
